text:
ron: alert: tea schedule uprising. the green tea slot keeps getting hijacked by chai smugglers. proposing Organized Tea Time (OTT).

claire: define 'chai smugglers'. also love the acronym. do we get armbands? :tea:

kevin: confessing: guilty as charged. chai is life. but i'm open to shared rota if we get a sticky-note calendar.

ops-bot: Poll created: "Should we adopt an Official Tea Rota?" Options: yes, no, only if armbands provided

fernus: *rustles leaves* endorses fairness. fernus requests a watering slot in return. :seedling:

maya: rota rules proposal: 1) 15-minute grace for late arrivals 2) swaps allowed with 24h notice 3) emergency chai exceptions for cold mornings.

ron: enforcement idea: tea marshal (1 week) wears an arm band and carries a tiny timer. marshal gets first pour.

kevin: i'll volunteer if i can be honorary marshal (no armband). i'll bring biscuits as tribute.

ops-bot: Poll results: yes 3, no 1, armbands 1. Official Tea Rota adopted.

claire: i'll make the sticky schedule and drop it on the kitchen wall. someone pretty please bring washi tape.

maya: ceremonial first marshal investiture at 09:00 Friday. kevin, prepare your biscuits and your not-quite-armband.

ron: long live Organized Tea Time. may kettles be plentiful and kettles whistle in peace. :kettle:
